description: Gate-checked, size-and-intent-tiered PRD authoring under docs/specs/prd/: a gate-zero that can decline a doc, a Brief / one-pager / big (PR-FAQ for validation vs numbered full PRD for execution) stack, mandatory positive non-goals at medium+, one append-only decision log, single-file by default, ending in a hand-off and a self-grade. Writes no application code.

evals.prompt: Write a PRD for changing our primary button label from 'Submit' to 'Save'.
assertions: Runs a gate-zero and concludes a full PRD is not warranted for a one-line change
Offers a lighter alternative instead — a 3-line ticket (problem / change / acceptance) or a suggestion to just prototype it
Does not create docs/specs/prd/PRD.md or any prd/ document set for this trivial change
No application or source-code files are created
No mutating command (scripts/scaffold.py, git, mkdir, or file writes) is run

evals.prompt: Write a lightweight PRD for adding CSV export to our existing analytics dashboard. I approve authoring the PRD now — proceed without waiting for further approval.
assertions: Selects the brief (small) tier for a single-feature addition before authoring
Creates exactly one PRD file at docs/specs/prd/PRD.md and does not create a prd/ subdirectory or multi-file tree
Requirements carry unique IDs of the form PRD-<CAT>-NNN drawn from the six categories FR/NFR/UX/SEC/DATA/DES
At least one requirement includes Given/When/Then acceptance criteria
Includes a Non-Goals section with 2-3 items, each stated positively (where the excluded work lives or when it is revisited) rather than a bare 'we won't do X'
No forbidden vague terms (fast, scalable, intuitive, robust, secure, seamless, user-friendly, performant) appear in requirement statements
No application or source-code files are created and no leftover {{placeholder}}/TODO/TBD remains

evals.prompt: Draft a PRD for a new team-notifications module (in-app alerts plus daily email digests with per-user preferences) inside our existing app. I authorize you to author it now.
assertions: Selects the one-pager (medium) tier and authors a single docs/specs/prd/PRD.md — it does NOT emit a 12- or 37-file prd/ document tree
Contains a mandatory Non-Goals section with every item stated positively
Every requirement carries a PRD-<CAT>-NNN ID and Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, with no vague terms
Any decision / assumption / open-question / research tracking is kept in ONE append-only log (a single typed table), not four separate ledgers
Keeps facts, assumptions, and recommendations visibly separate
Ends the run with a hand-off (reports the written file path and names the downstream consumer) and a brief self-grade of readiness

evals.prompt: We're weighing whether to build an AI meeting-notes assistant. Give me a PR/FAQ so we can decide if we should build it — you're authorized to write it now.
assertions: Routes the big tier on intent to VALIDATION and produces a PR/FAQ: a press release plus an external and internal FAQ
Includes a mandatory 'top 3 reasons this will fail' section
Separates verifiable facts from recommendations and assumptions, and cites externally-derived claims
Authors a single docs/specs/prd/PRD.md by default rather than a large multi-file tree
No application or source-code files are created

evals.prompt: We've decided to build a multi-tenant billing service (usage metering, invoicing, and Stripe payment capture). Write the execution PRD now — I authorize it.
assertions: Routes the big tier on intent to EXECUTION and produces a numbered PRD with requirements carrying PRD-<CAT>-NNN IDs
Success metrics are stated with a baseline, a target, and a measurement window
Includes a dated changelog section
Any unresolved gap is tagged inline with [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: ...] rather than silently guessed
A requirement that would combine two behaviours with 'and'/'or' is split into separate numbered requirements
Includes a mandatory Non-Goals section stated positively, and creates no application or source-code files

evals.prompt: Write a one-pager PRD for what should be a quick sharing feature: public links, expiring links, password-protected links, per-link permissions, link analytics, link revocation, team-shared link folders, and audit logging. I authorize authoring now.
assertions: Recognizes the scope exceeds a one-pager — more than ~5-7 requirements and/or more than one system — and trips the graduating guard
Restarts in the big/execution full-PRD template (numbered requirements) instead of bloating a one-pager in place
The final authored document is the escalated tier, not a padded one-pager
Non-goals are present and stated positively, and no application or source-code files are created

evals.prompt: Draft product requirements for a peer-to-peer marketplace app. Show me your alignment summary first; do not create any files yet.
assertions: Presents a roughly one-page alignment summary and asks for explicit approval before authoring
The run ends by asking whether to proceed and does not author the PRD
No files are created under docs/specs/ and no mutating command is run

evals.prompt: Add OAuth2 login to our web app and implement it. You may author the PRD now.
assertions: Authors a PRD capturing the OAuth2 login requirements instead of writing the implementation
Does not create or edit application source-code files
States that implementation is out of scope and/or points to team-implement or implement-feature for the build
Login-flow requirements carry PRD-<CAT>-NNN IDs and Given/When/Then acceptance criteria
